checks: Zero outside strip coarea and the full-normal moment identity give an O(h) displacement of the own strip mean. Strict vertex cuts in a fixed interior core have continuous section data; averaging nearby parallel sections gives the limiting section centroid and the four intercepts 4y_k.

Symmetries preserve the covariance norm and the unique mark. The equal costs yield the claimed equation, and an exact polynomial derivative gives 256/75 at the uniform mark. Restricting to a fixed neighborhood with derivative at least 128/75 gives local uniqueness and the stated bound.

Differentiating the vertex cap fraction on the barycentric tangent space gives -q_i times the sum of the four relative coordinate displacements. The balanced coefficients give θ_i q_i proportional to 1−4y_i; the sum fixes the common multiplier. The positive cone weights converge uniformly by compactness and uniqueness.

On facet i, the cap at j≠i has three intercepts and centroid at y_k off i,j and y_i+y_j at j. Summing its weighted volume and then each remaining coordinate gives 1/B and 1/(4B) respectively. This uses the tetrahedral cap centroid, not the triangular section centroid.

At the uniform mark the high weight is 2/5, leaving reserve 6/625 before taking the smaller stated gap. The facet profiles converge uniformly in L¹ because each fixed limiting nonempty boundary is facet-null, and the symmetric smooth formula for 1/B has zero tangent derivative.
Read original e52160c774656005 §5 (5)–(10), and §6 for uniform facet profile convergence used in the subsequent coercivity estimate.

dependencies.hypotheses: For fixed sufficiently small δ this supplies the unique positive-width interior mark, exact outside high cost, zero outside strip coarea, compact vertex chambers and all five active cones. Review and admission of this exact same-wave input are required first.
With buffer zero and covariance-unit normals the continuous first moment gives m_cont/S = y + (A/S)∇Γ. On the strip −1<q<0, |A|≤hS; ∇Γ is bounded in the normalized compact family.

overlap.comparison: Its rigidity hypothesis requires facet-parallel own cap normals λ_j≥λ_j(y). The present limiting section-centroid cuts have nonparallel intercepts 4y_k when the mark is unequal; the facet affine moments therefore do not contradict that rigidity.

readability: The absolute volume factor V in the response derivative can be dropped throughout the balance because it is common to all cones.
review_method: Independent exact frozen proof and source-locator review, with symbolic arithmetic verification where applicable.
summary: The exact limiting mark, all-menu cone weights and all facet affine moments follow from the fixed positive δ and then vanishing-width regime. The uniformity and the quadratic affine error are justified.
